threads.body: For http 2 it should report 2 not 2.0 and the same for http 3. Could consider adding a new helper to [`HttpProtocolUtil`](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/main/instrumentation-api/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/api/internal/HttpProtocolUtil.java) Or perhaps is this omitted because ratpack doesn't support http/2 anyway?

[General] Treat HTTP 101 as terminal here. A successful protocol upgrade does not have a later non-1xx response, so the current condition leaves the captured version null when `onEnd` clears the handler; this drops `network.protocol.version` from upgrade requests.
